author: render-agent
note: ungraded per-product layers (RGBA, straight alpha) and shadows (grey RGB, multiply) in work-r6/; grade_cut_r6.py grades and cuts them with the ONE v3c grade; the numbers here are measured on graded scenes recomposed with the change (set B)

vase.what: re-cut from the raw render (QA R5 3.1: the cut followed R4's placeholder and lost the lit flank); straightened and sized to the card about the foot; colour

method.edges: the vase's silhouette as the model drew it, row by row on its body (the rim + 3 to the foot's contact): the edges are the     sub-pixel peaks of the render's own colour gradient (Lab, sigma-0.6 blur; central differences): the right edge within 8 px inside /     3 px outside the old cut's (QA found that side right); the left edge within a window round the right edge's mirror about the     axis. The axis is fitted as a line on the rows where both edges are found (robust: two rounds, residuals over 2 px dropped), the     windows narrowed round it (10 px, then 5 px). The half width r(y) = (right - left) / 2, outliers against a 7-row median (> 1.5 px)     replaced by it, then smoothed (sigma 1.5 rows): a turned body is smooth. Returns per body row the axis and r, and the record
method.alpha: the re-cut alpha in the render's own coordinates: the body rows from the profile (the old cut's soft bottom row kept as a vertical     falloff), the old cut above the body (the lip, the branch)
method.straighten_and_size: the forward affine (render -> layer): the axis made vertical about the foot (x - tilt (y - foot_y): the camera is level, the     window's mullion is vertical in the same render, so the model's lean is the model's), then the card's size about the foot (sx, sy);     applied premultiplied (bilinear). Returns rgb, alpha, the matrix, the foot's axis x
method.shadow: extract.shadow_one (frozen, pass_r5.shadow_new) on the re-cut in the render's coordinates; then at the foot's scale (sx both ways about the foot: it lies on the bench), 1 under the full alpha

axis_check_in_layer.how: the alpha 0.5 mid-points of the body rows

colour.fix: the default vase: R5's a*b* fix re-solved on the re-cut body (post_r5.vase_colour's method and targets: one hue rotation and one     chroma factor for every body pixel, rows >= 935; the hue of the surfaces beside, L* unchanged), started from R5's dh and k. With its lit     flank back the lit half is lighter (L* 88 against R5's 79) and R5's k alone gives C* 3.4, under the designer's 4-7 and cooler than     the room's own white (the back wall, C* 4.05): the lit half is set to C* 4.5, inside the range and the nearest to the card's     near-neutral #EEECE8
